notes: College of Arts and Humanities' Religions of the Ancient Middle East Four Year Academic Plan. The source PDF's term grid converts to garbled, column-interleaved text (the by-term Fall/Spring grid and the separate Gen Ed/benchmark checklist table run together), so exact per-slot Fall/Spring placement could not be reliably reconstructed; flagged in docs/project/owner-review.md. Placement here follows the plan's legible signals: the 'RELS 271, 273, 274, or JWST 230' Big Question slot and 'RAME Foundation Course' labels appear in Years 1-2 (with 'Three RAME Foundation courses' as a Year-2 benchmark), 'RAME Elective 1xx-4xx'/'3xx-4xx' slots and the 'Four RAME Elective courses' benchmark appear in Years 3-4, and RELS408 (the Capstone) appears alongside an elective in Year 4. Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.
Big Question filled with RELS271, named directly by the catalog and the plan ('RELS 271 (HU, CC, & IS) RAME Foundation Course').
Sub-areas (three courses in two or more sub-areas) filled with JWST225, JWST231, and HIST120, all named directly by the catalog, department page, and plan footnote.

Electives (five courses, four must be upper level) filled with CLAS305, JWST325, JWST326, JWST430, and JWST468, all named directly by the catalog, department page, and plan footnote (all five are already upper-level, satisfying 'four must be at the upper level' with room to spare).
Capstone filled with RELS408, named directly by the catalog, department page, and plan.
